extract_batch with mixed valid and missing URI inputs

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val configDefault = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extractBatch(listOf(mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"text/plain.txt\"}", ExtractInput::class.java), mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"/nonexistent/missing.pdf\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)), configDefault)
    println(result)
}
```
